paper.title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents

latest_version.version_label: Protocol checked against arXiv v1 and official dataset release on 2026-09-17

evidence.paraphrase: Human-edited image-sharing conversations support long-term QA, event summarization and multimodal dialogue generation. QA includes unanswerable adversarial questions and retrieval evaluation. The original QA and summarization experiments use image captions; dialogue generation uses images directly. The authors note limited long-term visual consistency.

adjudication_notes: Restored to Table 2 under the broadened inclusion rule. Dataset-level multimodality must be distinguished from the caption-based QA protocol. No claim of native visual-memory evaluation applies to all tracks.
